title: workshop-rs/rule-content-v1
description: The versioned structured export of one Workshop rule's content, produced by workshop-rs from the canonical Program model. Every action, value, and operator is a call node named by its catalog id; literals, strings, enum members, and declared names use tagged forms. The document is deterministic for a given rule and independent of the source locale.

format.description: The versioned format identity. An incompatible change needs a new format id.

disabled.description: True when the whole rule is disabled.

actions.description: The rule's flat action stream: index i is Rule.actions[i]. Nesting is recoverable from If/Else If/Else/While/For and End call nodes.

Event.description: The event's catalog id plus the filters the event takes. `subroutine` is present only for a subroutine event.

id.description: The catalog event id: `global`, `eachPlayer`, `subroutine`, or a public `PlayerEventKind` catalog id such as `playerDealtDamage`.

team.description: Present only when the rule declares event filters.

player.description: Present only when the rule declares event filters.

subroutine.description: The declared subroutine name; present only when `id` is `subroutine`.

EventTeamFilter.description: A canonical EventTeam enum member id.

EventPlayerFilter.description: A canonical EventPlayer member id (`ALL` or `SLOT_n`), or a Hero enum member id (e.g. `ANA`).

disabled.description: Present only when the condition is disabled.
Present only when the action carries the disabled modifier. The modifier wraps the whole node.

CallId.description: A public catalog action, value, or operator id, or a documented reserved id. Reserved ids for constructs the catalog does not name: `globalVariable` (a global variable read, args = [variable]), `playerVariable` (a player variable read, args = [player, variable]), `assignMember` (a plain member assignment, args = [target, value]), `modifyMember` (a compound member assignment, args = [target, operation, value]), `memberAccess` (a receiver member read `receiver.member` or `receiver.member[index]`, args = [receiver, {"string": member}] or [receiver, {"string": member}, index]), `rawWorkshopAction` (an opaque action the parser preserved without canonical content, args = []). A modify operation is a zero-argument operator call such as `{"call":"add","args":[]}`; comparison operators likewise appear as call ids (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`).

Node.description: A value node: a JSON literal, a tagged string/enum/name, or a call.

localizedString.description: A preset localized string's catalog id.

enum.description: The canonical enum domain name, e.g. `Status`.

member.description: The canonical enum member id, e.g. `STUNNED`.

variable.description: A declared global or player variable name used as an argument.

subroutine.description: A declared subroutine name used as an argument.
